globalAnalysis.visualFlow: Trees and flower banks frame a stream that opens from the distant center toward the foreground, under a clear blue sky.
globalAnalysis.curatorialNote: Water should create smooth reflective phrases, flower banks should sparkle with dense organic motion, and the sky should remain sparse and open.

cells.label: Clear blue sky
cells.interpretation: A clear cool sky creates an open quiet ceiling.

cells.label: Tree crown entering the sky
cells.interpretation: A textured tree crown rises into the smooth sky.

cells.label: Sunlit upper trees
cells.interpretation: Two luminous canopies spread into the blue field.

cells.label: Sky above the far bank
cells.interpretation: Open sky settles onto a low distant tree line.

cells.label: Warm meadow horizon
cells.interpretation: A warm flat meadow separates sky from the denser garden.

cells.label: Dense left trees
cells.interpretation: Dark trunks and dense foliage form a strong textured wall.

cells.label: Central tree canopy
cells.interpretation: Interlocking light and shadow make the central canopy pulse organically.

cells.label: Right bank and distant shrubs
cells.interpretation: Layered vegetation guides the view toward the water opening.

cells.label: Blue and cream flower bank
cells.interpretation: Dense contrasting blossoms spread rapidly toward the stream.

cells.label: Flowers meeting reflection
cells.interpretation: Busy blossoms narrow into the smooth reflective channel.

cells.label: Stream opening
cells.interpretation: A calm vertical reflection opens a passage through the dense banks.

cells.label: Flowered right bank
cells.interpretation: Bright flowers curve inward around the reflective water.

cells.label: Dense foreground flowers
cells.interpretation: The closest bank breaks into many bright, high-contrast floral events.

cells.label: Flower bank dissolving into water
cells.interpretation: The dense bank loosens as colored marks enter the reflection.

cells.label: Blue foreground reflection
cells.interpretation: Smooth cool water extends the sky downward into the foreground.

cells.label: Dark water and bank edge
cells.interpretation: The reflective stream closes into a dark grounded edge.
